platform: macOS 26.5 (25F71), arm64, Apple Silicon; debug build 08b291d with embedded frontend, WKWebView through the test bridge (src-tauri/src/test_bridge.rs)
method: One isolated instance on the pinned engine, one project folder under the proof's temp folder, two conversations in it (one host). Messages typed in the real composer and sent with a real Enter; the model picker and Compact now are clicked in the page. The host's own state is read back through the app's list_models command per conversation (isActive), the label from the picker's trigger, the context reading from the ContextMeter.

limits: The unavailable model is sent through the app's set_model command from the page (the picker only lists the live catalog, so no click can choose one): the host's refusal (invalid_model, -32030) and the unchanged active model are measured, not a UI message.
One compaction on a short thread: its admission is shown; its result is not (finding above).
Labels are the engine's display labels, which equal the model ids on this engine.
findings: Shared code, not macOS: a conversation created from the welcome screen shows the picker as a bare 'Model' with no choices after its first turn (check fresh-picker), while list_models on its host already returns the five-model catalog with isActive. The catalog is only read at mount (no host yet: empty list) and on a conversation switch (set_active) or resume, so the picker fills once the user opens the conversation from the sidebar.

Shared code: after Compact now, the meter goes pending, then 'Compaction accepted — waiting for the engine…', then back to its generic copy after about 8 s, without saying whether the engine compacted or found nothing to do, and the reading stays at 31.8k (no new context usage arrived).
